generation.scope: At any rank-one point of an integral opposite octic with nonzero cubic tangent cone, a curve-valued generic kernel forces three lines. For nine cofactors the rank of the restricted kernel quadric determines the possible tangent nets. In particular a smooth cubic tangent cone forces ten independent cofactors and a surface-valued kernel.
